govdocs-archive_org-jfk-assassination-re: This archive.org item — JFK Assassination Records 2025 Release, Batch 02 — gathers newly declassified JFK files. The 2025 release belongs to the ongoing disclosures. Researchers await each new batch. The 1992 Act mandated the releases. The file is a primary source on the assassination.
govdocs-archive_org-national-socialist-a: This Nazi anthology — maker unknown, from the Berserker shelf — strings Nazi pamphlets. The file is hot evil-doctrine and needs a wary eye. Its hate bred the camps. Read it to know the foe. The shelf keeps it as proof.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-DukeStevenB_Duk: Steven Duke’s letter to Deputy Attorney General Richard G. Kleindienst is a legal note. Kleindienst served under Nixon. Letters to officials captured the era. The letter may hold a clue. The file belongs to the legal archive. The item is a fragment of correspondence.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-ModernPhotoBook: This FBI memorandum — Eric S. Galt letter to Modern Photo Bookstore — is a Bureau file. The declassified memo is a primary source. Galt was Ray’s alias. The memo may hold a clue. The file belongs to the government archive.
types-of-children-s-literature-a-collect: Educator Walter Barnes assembled this landmark anthology showing the many kinds of writing for children — fairy tales, fables, myths, poetry, and realistic stories. Each section is chosen to show teachers and parents what children's literature could be at its best. Long used in classrooms, it helped establish the serious study of books for young readers.
